newsitem.title: USA: Apogee Enterprises to buy Portland Glass.
newsitem.headline: Apogee Enterprises to buy Portland Glass.

text.p: Apogee Enterprises Inc said its wholly owned Harmon AutoGlass subsidiary signed a definitive agreement to buy Portland Glass in a stock-for-stock deal.

Apogee expects to complete the transaction in January, and president Donald Goldfus noted, "We anticipate the Portland Glass acquisition will meet Apogee's requirement of being accretive to earnings within the first year."
The acquisition does not include Portland's replacement window and commercial construction divisions, which will continue to operate under their existing management and ownership.
Apogee provides building products and services, glass technologies and auto glass.
